thread:
nina_research: Quick sync - q8x4 bringup had a weird divergence on the new multilang promptset (promptbank/multiq8-v1). We see BLEU down on translation-like anchors and completion truncation for >512 tokens.
sam_labelops: send examples pls. we should isolate whether this is quant-induced or prompt preproc.
nina_research: uploaded 90 stratified failures to s3: s3://redwood-dev/curation/q8x4-bringup/failures-1768.jsonl
u_scout_bot: anomaly detected  run_id=7893 metric=completion_length_p50 delta=-18.4% alert=low
oliver_infra: FYI the q8x4 runtime landed a newer kernel that pads KV cache differently; that could explain shorter outputs if cache eviction happens early.
emily_prod: can we have a quick canary route to compare q8x4 vs float on small traffic? want to avoid shipping a regressed model.
sam_labelops: will pull the 90, create a micro-golden of 40 (mix of translation and long narrative), and queue relabel with tag "truncation_vs_rewrite".
nina_research: also ran a tokenizer alignment check - found ~12 tokens mapping different between tokenizer v1/v3 for CJK sequences. Running dedupe with tokenizer=v3 as a test.
oliver_infra: I can spin a canary pool in staging for A/B. gives us live signal while labelops relabels.
u_scout_bot: scheduled re-eval: job=eval_1768 when new goldset appears.
sam_labelops: note to self - include raw source and tokenized_view in the microgold. labelers need to see if truncation is model output or beam cut-off.
emily_prod: if relabel confirms model error, fallback plan: route translations to float baseline for 12 hours while we iterate.
oliver_infra: canary pool up in ~45m. I'll post the endpoint once ready.
nina_research: timeline: dedupe-v3 test -> push microgold 40 -> relabel 24h -> live canary -> final decision. target 72h.
sam_labelops: starting ticket and recruiting two bilingual labelers now. will attach rubric and a few golden examples for calibrations.
oliver_infra: canary endpoint: https://staging-api.redwood/canary/q8x4-1768
nina_research: thanks all, will post diffs and a couple failing tokenized examples in the ticket.
